title: starmap/diff/v1
description: Each variable that was added, changed or removed between a git revision's spec and the spec in the working tree.

cut.description: Present when the output budget cut the result short, so data holds only its first rows.

budget.description: The most bytes that the run printed on standard output.

code.description: The over-budget code, in the tool's spelling.

data.description: The rows of the page, up to the limit.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

total.description: The number of rows that matched, of which data holds one page. It is absent when the tool did not count the rows.

truncated.description: True when the document leaves out rows that matched, because of the limit or the output budget, and false when data holds every row.

Change.description:
One difference between the two specs: a variable that was added or
removed, or one field of a variable that changed.

change.description: Whether the variable was added, changed or removed.

field.description: The field that changed, such as type or unset; null for a variable that was added or removed.

now.description: The field's value in the working tree, or the type, show and source of an added variable; null for a removed variable.

was.description: The field's value at the revision, or the type, show and source of a removed variable; null for an added variable.

Kind.description: How a variable differs between the two specs.

oneOf.description: The working tree declares the variable and the revision does not.
Both declare the variable, and this field differs.
The revision declares the variable and the working tree does not.
